name: The Awesome Trolls
source:
You are an adventurer. You and you friend, Aesop and Gada, go to explore a mysterious forest, but one day Aesop is missing. You are Gada is now going to rescue him from the danger.

[From [url=https://oice.com/story/dfe87d7ddeae4cb0aff63dd1e5cef775]Official site[/url]]
translation:
你是一名冒险者。你和朋友伊索、伽达一起探索神秘森林，但某天伊索失踪了。现在，你和伽达必须把他从危险中救出来。
